skill.name: Parrrley
skill.description: Shoots target, plundering Gold for each enemy unit killed.

skill.name: Cannon Barrage
skill.description: Gangplank signals his ship to bombard an area, slowing and damaging enemies.

skill.name: Lamb's Respite
skill.description: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.

skill.name: Rune Prison
skill.description: Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.

skill.name: Destiny
skill.description: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.

passive.name: Blast Shield
passive.description: Vi charges a shield over time. The shield can be activated by hitting an enemy with an ability.

rankValues.label: Shield as a share of max health
